The Ultimate Mowing Machines™

Durable. Comfortable. Designed to perform all day.

The Ferris ISX800 is engineered for operators who demand commercial-grade performance with smoother handling and comfort. Whether you’re maintaining large properties or working full-time in the field, this zero-turn mower brings power and dependability together in one rugged machine.

The new Ferris ISX800-60 with 26 HP engine features a 60” iCD™ fabricated cutting deck and patented ForeFront™ Suspension System to deliver a next-level mowing experience. With a commercial-grade Briggs & Stratton® 8260 engine, this mower is built for long days and tough terrain.

Features may include:

Reliable 26 HP Engine
Powered by a 26 HP Briggs & Stratton® Commercial Series 8260 V-Twin engine for dependable, efficient operation.

ForeFront™ Suspension System
Exclusive Ferris suspension with front upper and lower control arms and coil-over shocks for a consistent cutting height and smoother ride.

Heavy-Duty Fabricated Deck
60″ iCD™ Cutting System offers improved airflow and a clean, professional cut in every pass.

Hydro-Gear® ZT-3400® Transaxles
Deliver smooth, powerful performance with commercial-duty drive components.

Adjustable Cutting Height
Quick deck height adjustment from 1.5” to 5.0” in 1/4” increments allows precision control in varying conditions.

Comfort-Focused Design
Includes a deluxe high-back seat with suspension, armrests, wide foot platform, and ergonomic controls for operator comfort during long workdays.

Fuel Efficiency
5.5-gallon fuel tank offers extended mowing time with fewer stops.

Built to Work
Ideal for commercial operators or large landowners seeking performance and reliability season after season.
